basic_info.description: Just around the corner from Golden Gate Park and Rossi Pool, this freshly renovated masterpiece combines Victorian charm with modern needs. On the main level Calacatta Viola marble countertops adorn custom white oak cabinetry and high-end appliances from Bosch and Fisher & Paykel. An east-facing family room with built-in entertainment wall opens onto a spacious deck with a plumbed gas line. Towards the front of the home, a formal dining/living, guest suite, and powder room round out this floor. The white oak capped, custom-welded handrail precisely frames the stairs that traverse all 3 levels. On top is an entertainer's heaven including a lounge, bedroom, full bath, and exterior deck. South and East facing windows and skylights beam natural light throughout the home. The lower level is thoughtfully built with laundry room, storage closets, and 3 en-suite rooms whose bathrooms provide locally heated floors. Custom glass shower enclosures, designer tiling, and beautiful light fixtures round out the luxurious offering's interior. An EV-ready plug is in the garage, an electronically locked Delivery Closet enables secured package receipt even when you may be frequenting Coffee Movement, Arguello Market, Arsicault or any other of the area's attractions.
